resources.string: Keep the video frame fixed while the phone rotates. Choose an app or window directly in Galaxy’s recording start dialog. Settings apply to the next recording. Experimental: Android 16・17 / One UI 8・9, SM-S948Q. Enable this module for System Framework, SystemUI, and Samsung Capture, then soft-reboot the phone.
Master switch. When off, every extension below is disabled. Individual choices are kept for the next time you enable it.
Keep the initial video dimensions and rotate captured footage with the phone. Does not change the orientation of the phone itself.
Add app and window targets directly to the Galaxy recording start dialog.
For Galaxy, adds the Window recording area. For Android (AOSP), locks app recording to the main window selected at the start. Other screens in the same app are not substituted.
Allow hooks to be tried again. Soft-reboot the phone after resetting.
MIT project. Material Components and AndroidX: Apache License 2.0. libxposed API 102 is used only at compile time.
Individual features · active only when the master switch is on
Default playback audio scope for app recording. Override it in the Android or Galaxy recording start dialog. Microphone settings are separate.

Keep footage in the same direction when switching between opposite portrait or landscape orientations. Works with either recording start orientation, including landscape starts with black-bar correction off.
Targets are unavailable. Check module status.
No selectable windows. Open the app first.
No recent apps. Search or choose Other apps.
Keeps the recording notification on the left and hides the extra casting icon on the right during local screen recording. External casting indicators are preserved.
Unable to load the license file.

Galaxy only: bypass the speaker-only microphone branch of Media and mic, using Galaxy’s standard internal-audio and microphone mixer. When off, the speaker path uses microphone only. Does not change audio routing. Applies to the next recording.
Screen recording rotation, app targets, and audio options for One UI.
Keep capture controls out of saved images and videos

Exclude the Galaxy recording toolbar and post-screenshot controls from captured images and videos, including during rotation. Controls remain usable on the phone. Applies to the next recording or screenshot.
Hide the floating recording controls on the phone. Stop recording from the notification or the Screen recorder tile in Quick Settings. Applies to the next recording.
When off, Galaxy recording starts without the three-second countdown after you confirm the recording area and sound. Applies to the next recording.
Settings on this page apply to both recorders. Samsung Capture settings are in the Galaxy tab.
Applies to Galaxy recording and the controls shown after screenshots. Does not change Android (AOSP) recording controls.
Turn all extensions for Android (AOSP) and Galaxy on or off together.
Allow Samsung screenshots of windows protected with FLAG_SECURE. Screen recording has a separate switch. Protected video may remain black. Off by default.

Allow Android standard (AOSP) and Galaxy screen recorders to record FLAG_SECURE windows. Screenshots have a separate switch. Protected video may remain black. Applies to the next recording. Off by default.

Set media and microphone levels for Samsung recordings without changing device volume. Also available in Samsung Capture settings. Applies to the next recording. When off, Samsung volume behavior is used.
Galaxy Capture Tools extensions, separate from Samsung defaults
App audio scope, speaker behavior, recording levels
Area choices, countdown, recording indicators and toolbar
Screenshot restrictions and capture UI exclusion

Moves the original interactive Galaxy recording chip to the right, keeping tap and stop controls. Hides the duplicate casting icon. If the layout is incompatible or space is insufficient, keeps the chip on the left. Portrait display only.
Include call audio in internal audio

Add available call playback to internal audio. Off excludes playback classified as voice communication. Microphone capture follows the selected sound mode. The selected-app audio scope is preserved. Applies to the next recording; cellular calls and some audio routes may be unavailable.
